title: Bram and the Static
author: Hazel Eastwick
blurb: Jonah Pemberton, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
